title: 第9课 · 她的汉语说得跟中国人一样好
subtitle: HSK 3 · Lesson 9 — 她的汉语说得跟中国人一样好 · She speaks Chinese like a native

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在教室 — In the classroom

items.en: Chinese language
class
same, as...as...

items.zh: 大山：马可，你的中文越说越好了！
items.py: Dàshān: Mǎkě, nǐ de Zhōngwén yuè shuō yuè hǎo le!
items.en: Dashan: Mark, your Chinese is getting better and better!

items.zh: 马可：哪里哪里，我们班王静说得更好。
items.py: Mǎkě: Nǎli nǎli, wǒmen bān Wáng Jìng shuō de gèng hǎo.
items.en: Mark: Not at all. Wang Jing in our class speaks even better.
Dashan: How good?

items.zh: 马可：她的汉语说得跟中国人一样好。
items.py: Mǎkě: Tā de Hànyǔ shuō de gēn Zhōngguórén yīyàng hǎo.
items.en: Mark: She speaks Chinese as well as a Chinese person.

items.zh: 大山：王静？我怎么没听说过这个名字？
items.py: Dàshān: Wáng Jìng? Wǒ zěnme méi tīngshuōguo zhège míngzi?
items.en: Dashan: Wang Jing? How come I've never heard that name?

items.zh: 马可：她是我们的汉语老师。
items.py: Mǎkě: Tā shì wǒmen de Hànyǔ lǎoshī.
items.en: Mark: She's our Chinese teacher.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在蛋糕店 — In a bakery

items.en: the last one
to ease one's mind, to rest assured
definitely, certainly

items.zh: 小丽：别吃了，你已经吃了三块蛋糕了。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Bié chī le, nǐ yǐjīng chīle sān kuài dàngāo le.
items.en: Xiaoli: Stop eating, you've already had three pieces of cake.

items.py: Xiǎogāng: Zhè shì zuìhòu yī kuài.
items.en: Xiaogang: This is the last one.

items.zh: 小丽：你总是吃甜的东西，会越吃越胖。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Nǐ zǒngshì chī tián de dōngxi, huì yuè chī yuè pàng.
items.en: Xiaoli: You always eat sweet things; the more you eat, the fatter you'll get.

items.zh: 小刚：你放心，我一定不会变胖。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Nǐ fàng xīn, wǒ yīdìng bù huì biàn pàng.
items.en: Xiaogang: Don't worry, I definitely won't get fat.
Xiaoli: Why?

items.zh: 小刚：我们家的人都很瘦，吃不胖。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Wǒmen jiā de rén dōu hěn shòu, chī bu pàng.
items.en: Xiaogang: Everyone in my family is thin; we can't get fat no matter what we eat.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在山上 — On the mountain

items.en: to worry
fairly, rather
to know
first, in advance
middle
Xiaoli: I'm a bit scared.
Xiaogang: What's wrong?

items.zh: 小丽：山越高，路越难走。我也越爬越冷。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Shān yuè gāo, lù yuè nán zǒu. Wǒ yě yuè pá yuè lěng.
items.en: Xiaoli: The higher the mountain, the harder the path. And the more I climb, the colder I get.

items.zh: 小刚：不用担心，有我呢，我对这儿比较了解。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Bù yòng dān xīn, yǒu wǒ ne, wǒ duì zhèr bǐjiào liǎojiě.
items.en: Xiaogang: Don't worry, I'm here. I know this place quite well.

items.zh: 小丽：那我们先休息一下，一会儿再爬。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Nà wǒmen xiān xiūxi yīxià, yīhuìr zài pá.
items.en: Xiaoli: Then let's rest first and climb again in a little while.

items.zh: 小刚：好，一会儿我们可以从中间这条路上去。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Hǎo, yīhuìr wǒmen kěyǐ cóng zhōngjiān zhè tiáo lù shàngqu.
items.en: Xiaogang: OK, in a while we can go up by this path in the middle.

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 在小明家 — At Xiaoming's home

items.en: to participate
influence

items.zh: 同学：小明，你的眼睛怎么跟大熊猫一样了？
items.py: Tóngxué: Xiǎomíng, nǐ de yǎnjing zěnme gēn dà xióngmāo yīyàng le?
items.en: Classmate: Xiaoming, how come your eyes look like a giant panda's?

items.zh: 小明：我这几天脚疼，没休息好。
items.py: Xiǎomíng: Wǒ zhè jǐ tiān jiǎo téng, méi xiūxi hǎo.
items.en: Xiaoming: My foot has been hurting these past few days, so I haven't rested well.

items.zh: 同学：去医院了吗？医生说什么？
items.py: Tóngxué: Qù yīyuàn le ma? Yīshēng shuō shénme?
items.en: Classmate: Did you go to the hospital? What did the doctor say?

items.zh: 小明：他让我多休息。休息得越多，好得越快。
items.py: Xiǎomíng: Tā ràng wǒ duō xiūxi. Xiūxi de yuè duō, hǎo de yuè kuài.
items.en: Xiaoming: He told me to rest more. The more I rest, the faster I'll recover.

items.zh: 同学：下个月的篮球比赛，你能参加吗？
items.py: Tóngxué: Xià ge yuè de lánqiú bǐsài, nǐ néng cānjiā ma?
items.en: Classmate: Can you take part in next month's basketball match?

items.zh: 小明：一定能参加，一点儿影响也没有。
items.py: Xiǎomíng: Yīdìng néng cānjiā, yīdiǎnr yǐngxiǎng yě méiyǒu.
items.en: Xiaoming: I can definitely take part; it won't be affected at all.
